maddeler.e:
ابتعثوا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَعَثُوا (ibtaʕaṯū) /ib.ta.ʕa.θuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# اُبْتُعِثُوا (ubtuʕiṯū) /ub.tu.ʕi.θuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# اِبْتَعِثُوا (ibtaʕiṯū) /ib.ta.ʕi.θuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
